name: CSS
format:
<style>
    body {
        background-image: url("/image/azul.jpeg");
        background-repeat: no-repeat;
        background-size: cover;
        background-position: bottom left;
    }

    body.nr-dashboard-theme md-content md-card,
    .nr-dashboard-theme ui-card-panel {
        border-radius: 10px;
    }

    .md-icon-button,
    .md-toolbar-tools h1 {
        display: none;
    }

    .argazki,
    img {
        height: 100%;
        padding: 5px;
    }

    .dropdown {
        position: relative;
        display: inline-block;
    }

    .dropdown-content {
        display: none;
        position: absolute;
        background-color: #023966;
        box-shadow: 0px 8px 16px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
        min-width: auto;
        z-index: 1;
        margin-top: 10px;
        white-space: nowrap;
        right: 0;
        border-radius: 5px;
    }

    .dropdown-content button {
        text-decoration: none;
        display: block;
        width: 100%;
        padding: 10px;
        text-align: left;
        color: white;
        border: none;
        background: none;
        cursor: pointer;
    }

    i {
        margin: 5px;
        color: white;
    }

    #photos {
        height: max-content;
    }

    #Home_Home,
    #Home_Home_cards,
    #Search_Title,
    #Search_Title_cards,
    #Search_Results,
    #Search_Results_cards,
    #Simulation_Simulation,
    #Simulation_Simulation_cards,
    #Prediction_Prediction,
    #Prediction_Prediction_cards,
    #Prediction_Result,
    #Prediction_Result_cards,
    #Charging_Charging,
    #Charging_Charging_cards,
    #Forum_Input,
    #Forum_Input_cards,
    #Forum_Chat,
    #Forum_Chat_cards,
    #Simulation_Graph,
    #Simulation_Graph_cards {
        width: 95vw !important;
    }

    #Search_Results {
        height: max-content !important;
    }

    #Simulation_Simulation_cards md-card:not(:first-child) {
        padding-left: 33% !important;
        padding-right: 33% !important;
    }

    #Home_Home_cards md-card,
    #Search_Title_cards md-card,
    #Search_Results_cards md-card,
    #Prediction_Prediction_cards md-card,
    #Prediction_Result_cards md-card,
    #Simulation_Simulation_cards md-card,
    #Charging_Charging_cards md-card,
    #Forum_Chat_cards md-card,
    #Forum_Input_cards md-card,
    #Simulation_Graph_cards md-card,
    progress {
        width: 97% !important;
    }

    #Search_Title_cards md-card:not(:first-child),
    #Prediction_Prediction_cards md-card:last-child {
        padding-left: 25% !important;
        padding-right: 25% !important;
    }

    #Search_Chart,
    #Search_Table {
        width: 47.25vw !important;
    }

    #Search_Table_cards md-card,
    #Search_Chart_cards md-card {
        width: 100% !important;
    }

    #Home_Information_about_you {
        width: 27.25vw !important;
    }

    #Home_Our_funcionalities {
        width: 67.25vw !important;
    }

    #Charging_Charging,
    #Charging_Charging_cards {
        padding-top: 30vh !important;
    }

    #Tab_Forum {
        height: 90% !important;
        overflow-y: visible !important;
    }

    #Forum_Chat {
        height: 88% !important;
        overflow-y: auto !important;
    }

    #Forum_Chat_cards md-card {
        overflow-y: visible !important;
    }

    #Forum_Input_cards md-card {
        border-radius: 10px !important;
        border: solid black !important;
    }

    .container {
        background-color: #3d9d44;
        border-radius: 15px;
        padding: 10px;
        padding-top: 5px;
        margin: 10px 0;
        width: 50%;
    }

    .user {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: flex-end;
    }

    .darker {
        border-color: #ccc;
        background-color: #ddd;
    }

    #forum .container p {
        background-color: transparent !important;
    }

    .author {
        font-weight: bold;
        margin-bottom: 5px !important;
    }

    .time-right {
        text-align: right;
    }

    .container::after {
        content: "";
        clear: both;
        display: table;
    }

    .m-0 {
        margin: 0px;
    }

    .accordion {
        background-color: #eee;
        color: #444;
        cursor: pointer;
        padding: 18px;
        width: 100%;
        border: none;
        text-align: justify;
        text-justify: inter-word;
        outline: none;
        font-size: 15px;
        transition: 0.4s;
    }

    .active,
    .accordion:hover {
        background-color: #ccc;
    }

    .accordion:after {
        content: '\002B';
        color: #777;
        font-weight: bold;
        float: right;
        margin-left: 5px;
    }

    .active:after {
        content: "\2212";
    }

    .panel {
        padding: 0 18px;
        background-color: white;
        max-height: 0;
        overflow: hidden;
        transition: max-height 0.2s ease-out;
    }

    .adjust {
        width: 100%;
        height: auto;
    }

    .svg-loader {
        display: flex;
        position: relative;
        align-content: space-around;
        justify-content: center;
        padding: 10px;
    }

    .loader-svg {
        position: absolute;
        left: 0;
        right: 0;
        top: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        fill: none;
        stroke-width: 5px;
        stroke-linecap: round;
        stroke: rgb(64, 0, 148);
    }

    .loader-svg.bg {
        stroke-width: 8px;
        stroke: rgb(207, 205, 245);
    }

    .animate {
        stroke-dasharray: 242.6;
        animation: fill-animation 1s cubic-bezier(1, 1, 1, 1) 0s infinite;
    }

    @keyframes fill-animation {
        0% {
            stroke-dasharray: 40 242.6;
            stroke-dashoffset: 0;
        }

        50% {
            stroke-dasharray: 141.3;
            stroke-dashoffset: 141.3;
        }

        100% {
            stroke-dasharray: 40 242.6;
            stroke-dashoffset: 282.6;
        }
    }
</style>

name: Toolbar
Insert into toolbar
format:
<script id="titleScript" type="text/javascript">
    $(function() {
        if ($('.md-toolbar-tools').length != 0) {
            loadToolbar();
        } else setTimeout(loadToolbar, 500)
    });

    function loadToolbar() {
        var toolbar = $('.md-toolbar-tools');
        var argazki = $('.argazki');
        var div = $('#toolbar');
        toolbar.append(argazki);
        toolbar.append(div);
    }
    
</script>
